methodology.state: Begin risk-off at the first observed source-panel date. At every completed close, VIX>=VIX3M sets risk-off. Otherwise only an actual completed XNYS month end clears risk-off. Thus inversion wins on month end; a normal intervening day cannot restore exposure. The state runs through all real prehistory without resets at either account window. Source warmup rows remain entirely undefined.
